meta.basis: Every figure measured on a scratch copy of the saved model in one Excel session, inputs restored between scenarios. Solves are bisections with the achieved value recorded.
meta.restamped: One text cell was corrected after the measurement: a watchpoint on the Cheat Sheet tab whose cell is formatted as Text, so the formula written into it had been stored as a literal. Every value in both books was compared afterwards - 10,589 of them across the names, the P&L, the assumptions, the schedule, the cash flow and the checks - with no numeric difference, so the measurement stands against the re-stamped file.
